extracted.intended_audience: photojournalists, photographers, photo editors, festival participants and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Listing of awards and grants given annually by the Visa pour l'Image photojournalism festival in Perpignan, including prize pool, number/timing of awards, and the names of individual grants and awards. Intended to inform photographers/editors about available prizes and the selection context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: awards for best photojournalism projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Each year, Visa pour l'Image awards prizes for the best photojournalism projects from around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page states awards recognize the best reports/projects worldwide; no detailed eligibility or judging criteria are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prize pool: €150,000 in prize money
rubrics_metrics.description: Each year, €150,000 in prize money is awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total monetary amount awarded across the festival; the page does not break down amounts by prize.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number & timing: seventeen awards and grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Seventeen awards and grants are awarded each year during the screening evenings at Perpignan's Campo Santo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards are presented during the festival's screening evenings at Campo Santo; no further scheduling details provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process: juries of photo editors and photographers
rubrics_metrics.description: Photo editors and photographers take part in different juries and select the best reports of the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is by juries composed of photo professionals; the page does not list jury composition per prize or judging rubrics.
